hero.tagline: Where elegance, self-care, and celebration come together.
hero.intro: Located in the heart of a busy, welcoming neighborhood in Sherwood Park, The Nail Room offers an elevated beauty experience specializing in luxury manicures, nail extensions, pedicures, lashes, brows, group events, and more — all in one luxurious space.

items.title: Luxury Pedicure Lounge
items.body: Experience deep relaxation in our spacious, spa-inspired pedicure lounge — thoughtfully designed for comfort, tranquility, and elevated foot care in Sherwood Park.

items.title: Impeccable Cleanliness & Hygiene
items.body: Your safety is our priority. We follow strict sanitation protocols, use hospital-grade disinfectants, and maintain the highest standards of cleanliness so you can relax with complete confidence.

items.title: Perfect for Group Celebrations
items.body: From birthdays and bridal showers to corporate gatherings, our beautifully designed open-concept studio is the ideal destination for unforgettable group experiences.

items.title: Full Bar Experience
items.body: Enjoy complimentary beverages or elevate your visit with premium cocktails and handcrafted mocktails — because luxury is in the details.

items.title: Your All-in-One Beauty Destination
items.body: Conveniently located in Sherwood Park, we offer nails, lashes, and brows under one elegant roof — making self-care effortless.

items.title: Premium Products & Advanced Techniques
items.body: We invest in high-quality products and modern techniques that prioritize nail health, lasting results, and exceptional comfort.

items.title: Boutique Luxury, Close to Home
items.body: Locally owned and thoughtfully curated, The Nail Room delivers a refined beauty experience for clients who appreciate personalized service, attention to detail, and a welcoming atmosphere.

ourStory.lead: At The Nail Room, beauty is more than a service — it’s an experience.
paragraphs: We opened our studio with a vision: to bring an elevated, luxury beauty destination to Sherwood Park, where clients can relax, unwind, and celebrate life’s moments in a welcoming environment.

Our space is uniquely designed to feel open, airy, and luxurious — with a large pedicure lounge, spacious nail stations, and dedicated beauty areas for lashes and brows. Whether you’re visiting for a quiet self-care moment or hosting a private celebration with friends, we’ve created a setting that blends elegance with comfort.

Our team of experienced nail artists and beauty professionals are passionate about detail, creativity, and quality. Every service is performed with precision, care, and the highest standards — because you deserve nothing less.

images.alt: Luxury pedicure at The Nail Room

items.name: Luxury Pedicure Experience
items.body: A spa-like pedicure designed for ultimate relaxation. Includes a soothing foot soak, exfoliation, callus care, hydrating mask, massage, and premium polish or gel finish. Enjoy complimentary drinks or upgrade to our signature cocktails from the bar.

items.name: Signature Manicure
items.body: Beautifully shaped nails, refined cuticles, a gentle scrub, nourishing lotion, hydrating mask and your choice of high-quality polish or gel polish application.

items.name: BIAB Manicure
items.body: A strengthening, long-lasting manicure designed to help your natural nails grow stronger and healthier. This treatment provides added durability, a flexible structure, and a chip-resistant finish — making it the perfect choice for weak or brittle nails.

items.name: Nail Extensions
items.body: Acrylic, builder gel, gel X or sculpted extensions tailored to your length and style preference.

items.name: Custom Nail Art
items.body: From clean minimal designs to intricate works of art — our artists bring your vision to life.

items.name: Lash Extensions
items.body: Classic, hybrid, and volume lash sets that enhance your eyes while maintaining natural lash health.

items.name: Lash Lift & Tint
items.body: Effortless beauty — lifted, curled, and darkened natural lashes.

items.name: Brow Shaping & Tint
items.body: Precise shaping and soft, long-lasting tint enhance your natural brows, creating a balanced, and effortlessly polished look.

items.name: Brow Lamination
items.body: Fluffy, full, and lifted brows with a soft, refined finish.
